events.what: Robbie 的手机响了，正当他和 Matt 准备去接待处接 Isolde 时。Robbie 听完电话那头 forensics 的人，脸色一沉；他告诉 Matt 他得去 Institute，因为「那疯子说的不是隐喻意义上的隧道」，Forensics 真的找到了一条隧道。Matt 提议给 Caius 的父亲打个电话（因为地是他的）；Robbie 反问 Caius 为什么总不被派去处理持刀 gang 案、为什么总是些怪案子。Matt 耸肩说那他去跟 Isolde 谈。
key_verbatim: That nutter wasn’t talking about metaphorical tunnels. Forensics have bloody found one.
I’d give Caius’s dad a call in that case. It’s his land.
Why doesn’t he get assigned to gang stabbings? Why is it always weird?
I’ll speak to Isolde then.

events.what: Matt 在警局隔着桌子问 Isolde 的话，为录音做了自我介绍，并说同事 DI Caius Beauchamp 之前跟她谈过「有人用她的资料钓男人（catfish）」的事。Isolde 问是否抓到了人；Matt 答「我们相信抓到了」。
key_verbatim: Matt introduced himself for the recording. ‘My colleague DI Caius Beauchamp spoke to you before about someone using your details to catfish men.’
‘Yes, have you caught them?’
‘We believe we have.’

events.what: Isolde 说她这一周都吓坏了（petrified all week），觉得整件事很阴惨——有人偷走她生活的碎片去勾引并谋杀一个男人；她怀疑过见过的每一个人，甚至买了一台门铃摄像头。
key_verbatim: I’ve been petrified all week.
I bought one of those doorbell cameras for my house.

events.what: Matt 脸红，心里想她太性感了，不会坐在家里写那种东西，觉得这种女生只会被人睡而不是凭空想象；他于是说「我们认为他们关注你的同人（fanfic）账号」。
key_verbatim: He thought she was far too hot to be sat at home writing things like salad sex.
‘We think that they follow you on your fanfic account.’
‘My what?’ Isolde looked confused.

events.what: Matt 问「你不写中世纪性幻想？」；Isolde 否认：先是「绝对不」，被说「没必要害羞」后升级为「我不给网上的陌生人写黄色故事」；Matt 再问「你确定？」，她说「我当然非常确定」。她当场把笔记本电脑从包里拿出来，说自己本来打算去咖啡馆、申请意大利的英语教学岗位。
key_verbatim: ‘Do you not write medieval sexual fantasies online?’
‘Absolutely not.’ Isolde was offended.
‘There’s no need to be embarrassed—’
‘I do not write dirty stories for strangers on the internet.’
‘Are you sure?’
‘Of course I’m bloody sure.’
I was going to go to a cafe after and apply for English language teaching jobs in Italy.

events.what: Matt 要过她的笔记本——这样他们就不必去申请搜查令搜她的住处；他连上警局的访客 Wi-Fi，打开那个同人网站，发现她仍处于登录状态（‘You’re still logged in’），把电脑转过来给她看。
key_verbatim: it saved them having to get a warrant to search her place and get it
He logged on to the station’s guest Wi-Fi and opened up a new tab.
‘You’re still logged in.’ He spun the laptop around.

events.what: Isolde 看到主页后爆粗口「What the actual fuck?」，并说「这些我没写过任何一个」（I didn't write any of this）。她点开最后那篇故事，给出两条理由：第一，「我是英语的 lead——语法糟透了」；第二，「这东西发布时我正在上班，正值一个上学日的中间，我在 Stratford 的一所学校代课。我没带笔记本，它在家里。我工作时从不用自己的设备，连手机都关掉。我会树立什么样的榜样？」
key_verbatim: ‘What the actual fuck?’ Isolde stared at her homepage on the site. ‘I didn’t write any of this.’

‘I didn’t.’ She clicked on the last story. ‘Two things: firstly, I’m an English lead – the grammar is appalling. Secondly, I was at work when this was published. That’s right in the middle of a school day. I was substituting in a school in Stratford. I didn’t have my laptop, it was at home. I never use my own devices when I’m at work. I even turn my phone off. What sort of example would I be setting?’
events.note: Isolde 只否认「是我写的」，没有说「有别人冒我的名写」；也未回答「作者是谁」——原文里作者身份并未被她提出。

events.what: Matt 把电脑转回去，回到仪表板与「已发布故事的摘要」页面，问「这些日期你都在哪里？」（Where were you on these dates?）——本章到此为止，这个问题的答案不在本章。
key_verbatim: He went back to the dashboard and the summary of the stories posted. ‘Where were you on these dates?’

events.what: Matt 把她送出大楼（她拄着月球靴走路一瘸一拐），两人进电梯。Isolde 说「我感到被侵犯了」「为什么是我？」；Matt 说「我们很快就会查出来」，然后送她回接待处——她的前男友 Andy 在那里等她。
key_verbatim: She was walking unevenly with her moon boot.
‘I feel so violated.’ She turned to Matt. ‘Why me?’
‘We’ll find out soon enough,’
He walked her back to reception. Andy, her ex, was waiting for her.

events.what: Andy 问「一切都好吗？」并把手放在她背上；Isolde 说「我需要一杯烈酒」并提到「有人在网上写关于我的黄色故事」；Andy 说「天哪，太可怕了」。Matt 观察 Andy，觉得他先是短暂不安、然后是生气。Andy 把车钥匙交给 Isolde。
key_verbatim: ‘Everything OK?’ he asked, placing his hand on her back.
‘I need a strong drink,’
‘Someone’s writing dirty stories about me online.’
Matt watched Andy. He briefly looked disturbed, and then angry.

events.what: Isolde 拿钥匙一瘸一拐地走了。Andy 说不想她大老远坐公共交通来（她的脚）；Matt 说 overground 有座位，很体贴，还讽刺她「能跟前男友保持成熟的关系真好」。
key_verbatim: ‘I didn’t want her travelling all the way here on public transport. Her foot.’
‘They have seats on the overground,’ Matt said, smiling at Andy.
‘That’s very courteous of you. It’s nice that you can have a grown-up relationship with your ex.’

events.what: Andy 打听 Matt 的上司 DI Beauchamp 是否还管这个案子；Matt 答：不是了，是利益冲突——他刚发现他家拥有案发集中地区那些房产的租约权益（leaseholds）。Andy 随即自夸式地说：难怪他们难管住自己的产业；他们在 Hertfordshire 的宅子有很多 priest holes；Priory Square 有迷人的历史；「你知道吗？」
key_verbatim: ‘Look, am I to understand it that your boss, I guess, DI Beauchamp. The guy I met before. He’s not on the case any more?’
‘No, it was a conflict of interest. He just discovered that his family own the leaseholds in the area where the crimes have been concentrated.’
Their house in Hertfordshire has lots of priest holes.
And Priory Square has a fascinating history. Did you know that?

events.what: Andy 提到「你同事的祖先……」后故弄玄虚地停顿；Matt 答「我不知道」，并不明白 Andy 为什么看起来那么高兴。Andy 继续：当现在的房子在维多利亚时代建起、修道士院三百年来第一次被打开时，Beauchamp 一家就已经知道下面有什么；他们选择再封一次，像十六世纪的祖先那样；他们把修道院拆了，只留下地下墓室和地下层；至于 DI Beauchamp 和他家人现在是否知情则是另一回事；「要是老 Horatio 打通了我也不意外，他可是个 Boy's Own 式的变态，要是觉得下面有价值，他忍不住的」。
key_verbatim: ‘Your colleague’s ancestors …’ Andy sagely drifted off.
‘No, I didn’t,’ Matt replied. He wasn’t sure why Andy looked so pleased.
the priory was exposed for the first time in three hundred years, the Beauchamps already knew what was down there
They chose to seal it up again, like their ancestors had in the sixteenth century.
They knocked the priory down, you know. Left the crypt and basement levels only.
I wouldn’t be surprised if old Horatio knocked through. He was a Boy’s Own psychopath, after all.

events.what: Matt 只说「哦」。Andy 的嘴颤了颤，本来还想问 Matt 什么，但退缩了；他说「我最好把 Isolde 公主送回家」。
key_verbatim: ‘Oh.’
He wanted to ask Matt something else but backed off it.
‘Anyway, I best drive Princess Isolde back home.’

events.what: Matt 回到事故室自己的办公桌，开始看 35 号（number 35）门口监控摄像头的录像；他叫 Amy，问她还有没有那个「在邮局用过、能扫描录像的程序」；Amy 说「有」并把链接发给他。
key_verbatim: started watching the footage from the security cameras at number 35
‘Amy,’ Matt called over. ‘Have you still got access to that program you used for the Post Office that scans footage?’
‘Yep,’ she said and sent him a link.

chapter_boundary_notes: 本章以 Matt 的一句提问收束：‘Where were you on these dates?’（range 2943-3103）——这个问题的答案不在本章。
Isolde 被问及前的全部铺垫与提问都由 Matt 发出；Robbie 本章不在警局问话现场（他去了 Institute）。
原文没有任何一处由 Isolde 指认作者是谁；也没有任何一处把「冒名者是谁」写成既定事实。
